review.method: All non-null UI rows read; paired support names/categories/triggers compared by IDs offset 100. Existing project glossary consulted. Official franchise naming consulted where available. Draft pending orchestrator review.
notes: Preserved 43 ability names, 25 developer placeholder descriptions, 90 support names, 90 support categories, and 90 support triggers.
Fullwidth percent signs preserve source glyph style and avoid introducing printf sequences. No runtime placeholders exist in this table.
Developer placeholder text is translated literally, not replaced with invented ability effects.
Native font widths are recorded only; fitting and runtime validation remain with orchestrator.
Source パッセル differs from canonical バッセル; proposed Bassel is explicitly flagged.
